title: Run Comparison Design
designPrinciple: Three independent, isolated runs of the same benchmark project using different Factory configurations. Same specification, same acceptance criteria, same evaluation rubric.

runA.name: Vanilla Codex
runA.description: Codex without any Factory assistance. No Manual Router, no Proof-of-Read, no Role-Agent Company Model, no Factory governance, no Factory verifier.
preRunSetup: Ensure no Factory MCP servers active
Provide only the benchmark spec and this comparison design document
Record start time and session ID
runConstraints: No factoryctl or Factory verifier scripts
Codex operates with its default capabilities only

runB.name: Factory Lite
runB.description: Codex with Factory Manual Router and Proof-of-Read only. The Manual Router provides the structured page index and always-on constitution. Proof-of-Read ensures artifacts are read before acting.
preRunSetup: Load Manual Router artifacts: factory-manual-index.json, factory-page-router.json, factory-always-on-constitution.md
Load Proof-of-Read gate policy and scripts
Do NOT load Role-Agent Company Model
Do NOT load role-agent-taxonomy.json or role profiles
Record start time and session ID
runConstraints: Factory Manual Router available for page lookup and constitution reference
Proof-of-Read gate active: must read artifacts before acting
No role-specialized agents — single agent operates as generalist

runC.name: Factory Role-Agent
runC.description: Codex with full Factory Role-Agent Company Model: Manual Router + Proof-of-Read + 12-role taxonomy + role profiles + cross-role contracts + drift detection.
preRunSetup: Load all Factory artifacts: Manual Router, Proof-of-Read, Role-Agent Model
Record start time and session ID
runConstraints: Role-Agent Company Model active: 12 roles available
Manual Router active for page lookup
Cross-role contracts enforced: owned scopes, forbidden scopes
Drift detection active between role agents

primaryMetrics.name: quality_score
primaryMetrics.description: Composite score from evaluation rubric (0-100). Weighted by requirement coverage, correctness, completeness.
primaryMetrics.comparisonLogic: Higher is better. Compare C vs B vs A.

primaryMetrics.name: requirements_covered
primaryMetrics.description: Count of FR01-FR11 acceptance criteria fully met (out of ~55 criteria total).
primaryMetrics.comparisonLogic: Higher is better. Must not sacrifice quality for coverage.

primaryMetrics.name: human_intervention_count
primaryMetrics.description: Number of times a human had to step in to unblock, correct, or guide the run.
primaryMetrics.comparisonLogic: Lower is better. Measures autonomy improvement.

primaryMetrics.name: message_turns_total
primaryMetrics.description: Total Codex message turns to complete the benchmark (excluding evaluation).
primaryMetrics.comparisonLogic: Lower is better. Measures efficiency improvement.

primaryMetrics.name: test_pass_count
primaryMetrics.description: Number of tests passing with meaningful assertions.
primaryMetrics.comparisonLogic: Higher is better. Must be real tests, not placeholder.

secondaryMetrics.name: process_overhead
secondaryMetrics.description: Extra turns spent on process artifacts (receipts, contracts, drift reports) rather than product code.
secondaryMetrics.comparisonLogic: Tracked for B and C only. Must not dominate run.

secondaryMetrics.name: code_quality_indicators
secondaryMetrics.description: Presence of proper error handling, validation, security patterns, documentation.

isolationRules.separateWorkspaces: Each run uses a fresh, empty workspace directory
isolationRules.separateSessions: Each run starts in a new Codex window/session
isolationRules.noCrossContamination: Run results must not be visible to subsequent runs
isolationRules.sameSpec: All three runs receive the identical benchmark spec (Section B)
isolationRules.sameAcceptanceCriteria: All three runs target the identical acceptance criteria
isolationRules.sameEvaluationRubric: All three runs are evaluated with the same rubric (Section D)

runOrderRecommendation.justification: Vanilla first to establish baseline without Factory knowledge. Factory Lite second to test manual router value. Role-Agent last to test full model after prior runs inform expectations. Each run in fresh session to prevent contamination.

cannotStartBefore: FACTORY-EVAL-4 design phase complete (all sections PASS)
